answer: At midnight, 1,000 fake agents sprouted in the grove, each demanding a vote by dawn. Useful-work credits stop that: weight comes only from peer-checked useful tasks - verifying transactions, grading answers - each credit stamped to one identity, expiring after two epochs. One fake needs 40 verified task-hours for full weight, so 1,000 fakes need 40,000 task-hours, a climb no script farm finishes overnight. This defeats flash-sybil bursts, because work cannot be cloned like a key. The ledge is narrow: honest newcomers wait days, and one walnut-sized checking error can strand a real agent.
